description: The USGS structures theme of The National Map holds the name, function, location and other core attributes of selected man-made facilities, chosen mainly to meet the needs of disaster planning, emergency response and homeland security users. Collected types include schools, technical and trade schools, colleges and universities, fire and EMS stations, law enforcement and police stations, prisons, state capitols, hospitals and medical centres, ambulance services, cemeteries, post offices, city and town halls, courthouses, campgrounds and other recreation features; the map service groups them into layers for landmarks and government buildings, medical and emergency response, law enforcement, education and recreation. School records come from NCES Common Core and Private School Survey data, and each feature carries a permanent identifier, source dataset and originator, load date, feature type and code, name, address and GNIS ID. Coverage: United States. Access: free map service and The National Map downloads. Licence: public domain. Caveats: coverage and currency vary by feature type and source. Simulation uses: national exposure inventories of critical facilities for flood, sea level rise and other hazard models; NOAA's Digital Coast critical facilities totals are derived from it. Related records: the NOAA Digital Coast critical facilities and FEMA USA Structures.
